channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Golden State Valkyries Win Inaugural WNBA Championship
item.description: The Golden State Valkyries have won the WNBA championship in only their second year in the league. The Atlanta Dream, featuring Angel Reese, fell short in Game 7 of the finals. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Ravens Quarterback Lamar Jackson Injured, Ruled Out of Game
item.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was ruled out of the game after sustaining an injury to his right throwing hand's thumb during the first play against the Buffalo Bills. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Arsenal contract talks and transfer targets discussed
item.description: Mikel Arteta has provided an update on contract talks for Arsenal player Rice. Separately, there is discussion about a potential transfer target for the Gunners, described as an 'extraordinary' talent costing £58 million, with Mikel Arteta… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Fallon Sherrock Wins Darts Tournament, Defeating Luke Littler
item.description: Fallon Sherrock has won a darts tournament, defeating Luke Littler. She was awarded £501,000 (approximately $670,000) for her victory. Sherrock has responded to criticism following her win. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Johns Hopkins Wins Football Game on Rare Fair Catch Kick
item.description: Johns Hopkins secured a last-second victory over Muhlenberg in a Division III football game using a rare fair catch kick. This play had been out of college football for 76 years. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Judoka Mati Anes Wins Canada's First Youth Olympics Medal
item.description: Judoka Mati Anes secured Canada's first medal at the Youth Olympics held in Dakar, Senegal. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sharks Cancel Swim Leg of Noosa Triathlon
item.description: The swim leg of the Noosa Triathlon was cancelled due to multiple shark sightings. Australian triathlete Matt Hauser successfully defended his title in the event. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Injured Jockey Aims for Melbourne Cup Comeback After Fall
item.description: Jockey has undergone a procedure following a fall on Saturday and is reportedly aiming for a "miracle" comeback to ride in the Melbourne Cup on Tuesday. Coverage highlights the jockey's resilience, with one report stating, 'Jockeys are… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nottingham Forest Manager Faces Pressure After Team's Performance
item.description: Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner is facing increased pressure following a recent match where his team's performance has led to speculation about his potential dismissal. One report noted that Glasner engaged in an "X-rated" rant… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: College Football Playoff Picture Shifts After Week 9
item.description: Following Week 9 of the college football season, shifts have occurred in the Southeastern Conference (SEC) standings and the College Football Playoff (CFP) bracket predictions. The changes indicate movement among top-ranked teams vying for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Canelo Alvarez Wins WBC Super Middleweight Title from Christian Mbilli
item.description: Canelo Alvarez defeated Christian Mbilli by unanimous decision to regain the WBC super middleweight title. The fight saw Alvarez secure a vital win, keeping his career prospects strong after dominating Mbilli. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Shnaider defeats Fernandez in Pan Pacific Open final
item.description: Diana Shnaider has won the Pan Pacific Open final, defeating Leylah Fernandez after a rally. Fernandez had reached the final in Tokyo, described as being in-form. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mbappé Scores as Real Madrid Wins, Lazio Secures Late Victory
item.description: Kylian Mbappé scored for Real Madrid in their easy victory over Santander. Separately, Lazio secured a late winner to go top in Italy. Real Madrid's coach, Mourinho, stated that the "Mbappé, China issue" was over. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Crystal Palace Manager Pierre Sage Faces Pressure After Tottenham Loss
item.description: Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage has stated he will not give up despite mounting pressure following a defeat to Tottenham. His future at the club is reportedly hanging in the balance after the loss. The coverage also mentions Roberto De… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Liverpool and Arsenal clash sparks penalty debate and mixed reactions
item.description: In a recent Premier League match between Liverpool and Arsenal, Liverpool were praised for a brave display but were denied a penalty, prompting player Iraola to tell teammate Isak to start diving; Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he would… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Notre Dame defeats Villanova in Rome basketball season opener
item.description: The Notre Dame Fighting Irish defeated the Villanova Wildcats 74-72 in their college basketball season opener, which took place in Rome. Pope Leo met with both the Villanova and Notre Dame basketball teams at the Vatican. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Almgren Wins NYC Marathon Debut, Chepkirui Takes Women's Race
item.description: Andreas Almgren won the New York City Marathon in his first attempt at the distance. In the women's race, Sheila Chepkirui emerged victorious in a contest featuring past champions. The coverage also noted details such as start times for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Pakistan Wins Tri-Series Final Against Sri Lanka
item.description: Pakistan secured a three-wicket victory over Sri Lanka in the final of a tri-series cricket tournament. Fakhar Zaman scored 127 runs, a performance described as blistering, which was instrumental in Pakistan's win. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: South Africa Secures Series Win Against Ireland
item.description: South Africa has clinched a series win against Ireland, with Simon Harmer playing a key role. Harmer achieved his first Test 10-wicket haul, finishing with figures of 10 for 120, including 6 wickets for 16 runs in the second innings… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Brighton Defeats Manchester City, Manchester United Loses to Chelsea
item.description: Brighton secured their first away victory against Manchester City in their 18th attempt, winning 1-0. This result ended Manchester City's hopes of challenging for the title. In another match, a 10-man Manchester United was defeated by… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Kimi Antonelli Becomes Youngest Formula One Champion at 20
item.description: Kimi Antonelli has become the youngest ever Formula One champion at the age of 20. He secured his historic first F1 title at the Mexico City Grand Prix. Antonelli drives for Mercedes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Mohun Bagan Tops ISL Table After Comeback Win Over Punjab FC
item.description: Mohun Bagan rallied from an early deficit to defeat Punjab FC 2-1, securing the top position in the Indian Super League standings. The comeback was fueled by two opportunistic strikes in the first half, with goals attributed to Erwin and… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Manisha Wins Historic Wrestling Gold, Becomes First Indian Woman World Champion
item.description: Manisha Bhanwala has become the first Indian woman wrestler to win a World Championship gold medal, achieving the feat in Astana. Her victory fulfills a promise made to her father. She is planning to compete in the 57kg category at the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: New Zealand A fights back with century after early wickets
item.description: New Zealand A reached 218/3 from a precarious 13/3, thanks to a century by Matthew Bowles. Indian bowlers Mukesh Kumar took two wickets and Mohammed Siraj took one wicket. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Rishabh Pant's Test comeback uncertain due to injury
item.description: Cricketer Rishabh Pant's availability for the first Test against New Zealand is uncertain as his comeback faces another setback. He may miss India A's third unofficial Test against New Zealand A. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cricket Selection Debate: Kaif Criticizes India's Squad for New Zealand T20I
item.description: Former cricketer Mohammad Kaif has criticized the Indian team's selection for the T20 International series against New Zealand. Kaif specifically questioned the axing of Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and the recall of Ishan Kishan. The discussion… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ishan Kishan, Abhishek Sharma Set New T20 Boundary Records
item.description: Ishan Kishan has set a new record for the most boundaries hit in a calendar year in T20 cricket, with Abhishek Sharma ranking third. Both players are among the top five batters to achieve this feat. Separately, Shreyas Iyer became the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: New Zealand Wins 5th T20I Against India, India Clinches Series 3-2
item.description: New Zealand secured a seven-wicket victory in the fifth and final T20 International against India. Tim Seifert scored 93 runs, and Glenn Phillips also contributed significantly, guiding New Zealand to the win. Despite this consolation… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Rams WR Puka Nacua Suffers Calf Injury in Practice
item.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua sustained a calf injury during practice on Thursday. The extent of the injury and its impact on his availability for upcoming games were not immediately specified. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Fan banned after flipping off Florida players
item.description: A fan has been banned from Texas's stadium after being caught on video flipping off Florida players following the Gators' upset victory. ESPN is evaluating Jon Sumrall's first season at Florida. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Horse racing boss emails owners after Caulfield Cup death
item.description: Racing Australia chief executive Barry Maude sent an email to horse owners following the death of a horse at the Caulfield Cup carnival. The email served as a 'stark reminder' of the risks involved in racing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: USA to host inaugural Women's Club World Cup in 2028
item.description: The United States will host the inaugural FIFA Women's Club World Cup in 2028. FIFA announced the decision. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sheetal Devi wins three medals at Hangzhou Asian Para Games
item.description: Archer Sheetal Devi won three medals at the Hangzhou Asian Para Games. She has expressed a desire to compete in the Olympics. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Sheetal-Toman and Swati win historic medals at World Championships
item.description: The Sheetal-Toman pair won a gold medal, while Swati secured a historic medal at the World Championships. Swati's achievement marks India's first medal in the W1 category. Sheetal also achieved a double gold, matching her previous tally… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Samson's T20I Performance Addresses Critics
item.description: Sanju Samson has performed well in the T20I series, with his recent heroics addressing criticism. Samson stated that he does not play to prove people wrong, referencing social media noise. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship to be held in Ahmedabad
item.description: The first Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship will be held in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, from October 23. The event is expected to feature over 400 athletes from 13 nations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India vs New Zealand T20I: Phillips Stars in Record Innings
item.description: In the first T20 International between India and New Zealand, Glenn Phillips scored 82 runs off 40 balls, contributing to a record innings for New Zealand against India. Despite New Zealand's strong start, Indian bowlers managed to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Harry Brook Hits Fastest Double Century, Surpassing Shubman Gill's Record
item.description: England cricketer Harry Brook has set a new record for the fastest double century in One Day Internationals (ODIs), surpassing Shubman Gill's previous record which lasted less than a month. Brook achieved this feat during a match where a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Anahat Singh Defeats World Champion El Sherbini at Silicon Valley Open
item.description: Indian squash player Anahat Singh defeated eight-time world champion Nour El Sherbini of Egypt in straight games at the Silicon Valley Open. Singh had previously defeated Nour Aboulmakarim in the first round. El Sherbini is ranked world… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ranji Trophy Cricket Teams Achieve Early Season Success
item.description: Kerala has secured the top position in the Ranji Trophy following a victory over Odisha. Skipper Vishnu Vinod and coach Asnodkar attributed the win to a "total team effort," highlighting the team's batting depth and effective spinners… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
